config.principle: Feature-level GIS tables for the reading agents. The agents read and interpret the features; code only clips, measures, joins and counts. The activity-density heat proxy and zoning are read together and are auxiliary evidence: neither decides demand, a station role or a configuration.

heat_proxy.metric: activity density = (2020 Census residents + 2023 LODES jobs located in the cell) per acre of land in the cell
heat_proxy.label: PROXY built from public counts; not a measured activity or ridership heat map
heat_proxy.residents_source: 2020 Census P.L. 94-171 block counts (P1_001N), carry disclosure-avoidance noise; a different source and year than the ACS 2020-2024 estimates of the demography layer and never mixed with them
heat_proxy.jobs_source: LEHD LODES 8 Florida 2023 WAC C000 JT00 by block (jobs package)
heat_proxy.apportionment: block value x (block land inside the cell / block land), water erased; the same land-share convention as the other layers
heat_proxy.hot_definition: network top quintile of activity density among cells with land
heat_proxy.known_limitation: block values are spread evenly over the block's land; a park, plaza or parking structure inside a block inherits the block's density, so a hot cell must be read together with its zoning and land use before it is interpreted

roads.grouping: ways grouped by (name or ref, highway class) inside the half-mile disc; minor classes (rank >= 12) listed only when at least 330 ft lie inside the disc

parcels.privacy: no owner, mailing, site-address or legal-description field is requested or stored
parcels.table_rule: a parcel is listed individually when it lies in the inner band (within 660 ft), or its land-use group is one of listed_groups, or its lot is at least 20,000 sq ft; all other parcels appear only in the per-group summary; rows are ordered by distance and capped at max_rows
parcels.grouping_note: groups are defined on the description strings carried by the county layer itself (the text before ' : ' in DOR_DESC); a prefix that is not listed falls into 'other' and is reported; 'agricultural_classification' is a tax classification that appears on a few downtown parcels and is kept as the source gives it

role_hints.purpose: an independent, rule-based reading used only to measure how often the agents agree with simple rules and to queue disagreements for human review; hints never override an agent and never decide anything

rules.GH-01: road of class motorway / trunk (or their links): obstacle candidate
rules.GH-02: railroad trackage or the Metrorail line: obstacle candidate (and, for Metrorail, a transfer connection context)
rules.GH-03: existing Metromover guideway: facility to convert
rules.GH-04: parcel in the vacant or parking group with a lot at least as large as the smallest platform module footprint: candidate site candidate
rules.GH-05: parcel in the governmental group: public-owner context
rules.GH-06: heat cell in the network top quintile whose activity is mostly jobs (>= 70 %): destination context; mostly residents (>= 70 %): origin context
rules.GH-07: heat cell in the network top quintile touching a motorway / trunk road or rail, or dominated by an industrial, utility or transport land-use class: possible non-passenger or through activity - screen, never delete
rules.GH-08: land-use class of water: obstacle context

rail.source: Miami-Dade County Railroads layer (no attributes) + MetroRail Line layer + GTFS Metromover shapes
rail.split_rule: the county Railroads layer draws the Metromover guideway and the Metrorail line as rail without any attribute; trackage within 20 m of the GTFS Metromover shapes is reported as the existing guideway (facility to convert), trackage within 20 m of the Metrorail line as Metrorail, and only the remainder as other railroad trackage
rail.why: read as it comes, about three quarters of the 'railroad' length in the study window would be the transit lines themselves

transform.operation: Inverse of NAD83 to WGS 84 (1) + UTM zone 17N (with axis order normalized for visualization)
transform.pipeline: proj=pipeline step proj=unitconvert xy_in=deg xy_out=rad step proj=utm zone=17 ellps=GRS80
transform.accuracy_note: PROJ-reported accuracy of the datum operation selected in THIS environment; not the precision of the source geometries or of the model

method_summary: OSM roads, county rail, GTFS guideway shapes, Miami 21 zoning, county land use and parcels clipped to each half-mile disc with citable object ids; an activity-density heat proxy (2020 block residents + 2023 block jobs per acre, 500 ft cells) with zoning, land use and road context per cell; role hints kept apart for evaluation
contract: coze/v2/DESIGN.md (reading agents G1, G2); rules doc 规则 4, 6
